# convoy_event_types (Data Source)

List the event types of a project.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "convoy_event_types" "all" {}

# Subscribe an endpoint to every non-deprecated event type.
resource "convoy_subscription" "everything" {
  name        = "acme-everything"
  endpoint_id = convoy_endpoint.acme.id
  filter_config = {
    event_types = data.convoy_event_types.all.names
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `include_deprecated` (Boolean) Include deprecated event types. Defaults to `false`.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`.

### Read-Only

- `event_types` (Attributes List) Event types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--event_types))
- `names` (List of String) Event type names, convenient for `filter_config.event_types`.

<a id="nestedatt--event_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `event_types`

Read-Only:

- `category` (String) Category.
- `deprecated_at` (String) Deprecation timestamp, if deprecated.
- `description` (String) Description.
- `id` (String) Event type ID.
- `json_schema` (String) JSON schema, as a JSON string.
- `name` (String) Name.
